name: Trawl
description: Trawl is a self-hosted web scraping engine and a FlareSolverr / Byparr drop-in replacement. It bypasses JS challenges and captchas — Cloudflare, Turnstile, Interstitial, reCAPTCHA v2, hCaptcha and GeeTest — and returns cookies + user-agent over a FlareSolverr-compatible API on port 8191. Works out of the box with Prowlarr, Jackett, Sonarr, Radarr and the rest of the *arr stack. Powered by a fingerprint-patched Camoufox (Firefox) browser pool with a 4-tier escalation strategy (plain HTTP fetch -> cached browser session -> fresh Cloudflare solve -> residential proxy). Runs standalone out of the box. For faster repeat requests (bypass cookies cached in Redis), point REDIS_URL at a separate Redis container. Note: this image needs a larger shared-memory segment for the browser pool — the template sets --shm-size=1g via Extra Parameters. Do not remove it.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent state. Holds the MITM proxy CA (/data/proxy-ca) so it survives container recreation.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: FlareSolverr-compatible API port. Point Prowlarr/Jackett at http:// :8191/v1.

ports.name: MITM Proxy Port
ports.description: Host port for the MITM forward proxy. Only needed when Enable MITM Proxy is true.

variables.name: Browser Pool Size
variables.description: Number of concurrent browsers kept warm. Higher = more parallel throughput but more RAM (~1 GB each). Use 1 on low-memory systems.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional. Point at a separate Redis container (e.g. redis://REDIS-IP:6379) to cache bypass cookies for ~500ms repeat requests. Leave empty to run standalone with an in-memory cache.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Timezone used in log timestamps, e.g. America/Edmonton.

variables.name: Proxy URL
variables.description: Optional upstream proxy for the Tier 3 browser solve, e.g. http://user:pass@host:port.

variables.name: Residential Proxy URL
variables.description: Optional residential proxy used for the Tier 4 (last-resort) escalation.

variables.name: Enable MITM Proxy
variables.description: Optional browser-backed HTTPS forward proxy. When true, also publish the MITM Proxy Port below. Only expose it to trusted clients — it can impersonate any host to a client that trusts its CA.

variables.name: MITM Proxy Host
variables.description: Bind address for the MITM proxy inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 so it is reachable through the published port.

variables.name: MITM Max Tier
variables.description: Cap the escalation tier the MITM proxy uses (e.g. 3 to keep it off residential Tier 4). Empty = up to 4.

variables.name: MITM Debug
variables.description: Log one line per proxied request (noisy). Errors are always logged.

variables.name: STT URL
variables.description: Optional local Whisper server for reCAPTCHA audio solving (fully air-gapped), e.g. http://whisper:8080/inference. Empty = Google's free STT endpoint.

variables.name: STT API Key
variables.description: Optional API key for the local Whisper STT server, if it requires one.
